title: Clinical Reasoning Process of Physiotherapists When Observing Hemiplegic Gait
brief_summary: The goal of this study is to find out what clinical reasoning process physiotherapists undergo when observing hemiplegic patients gait.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* chartered physiotherapists
* physiotherapists in training
* working with stroke patients

Exclusion criteria:

\- other languages than German
